formal: budget_budgeter(total, weights) raises ValueError("total must be non-negative")
budget_budgeter(total, weights, minimum) raises ValueError("minimum must be non-negative")
budget_budgeter(total, [0, 0, 0]) raises ValueError("all weights are zero")

precondition: total >= 0 and minimum >= 0 and weights is non-empty and not all zero
formal: all(a >= 0 for a in budget_budgeter(total, weights, minimum))

precondition: total >= 0 and minimum >= 0 and weights is non-empty and not all zero
formal: all(a >= minimum for a in budget_budgeter(total, weights, minimum))

precondition: total >= 0 and minimum >= 0 and weights is non-empty and not all zero
total >= 0 and minimum >= 0 and weights is non-empty and not all zero
total1 >= total2 >= 0 and minimum >= 0 and weights is non-empty and not all zero
formal: all(a1 >= a2 for a1, a2 in zip(budget_budgeter(total1, weights, minimum), budget_budgeter(total2, weights, minimum)))

precondition: minimum1 >= minimum2 >= 0 and total >= 0 and weights is non-empty and not all zero
formal: all(a1 >= a2 for a1, a2 in zip(budget_budgeter(total, weights, minimum1), budget_budgeter(total, weights, minimum2)))

precondition: total >= 0 and minimum >= 0 and weights is non-empty and not all zero and k > 0
formal: budget_budgeter(total, [k*w for w in weights], minimum) == budget_budgeter(total, weights, minimum)

precondition: total >= 0 and minimum >= 0 and weights is non-empty and not all zero and k > 0
formal: budget_budgeter(k*total, weights, k*minimum) == [k*a for a in budget_budgeter(total, weights, minimum)]

precondition: total >= 0 and minimum >= 0 and weights is non-empty and not all zero and all(w == weights[0] for w in weights)
formal: budget_budgeter(total, weights, minimum) == [max(minimum, total // len(weights))] * len(weights)

precondition: minimum >= 0 and weights is non-empty and not all zero
total >= 0 and minimum >= 0 and weights is non-empty and not all zero
formal: all(isinstance(a, int) for a in budget_budgeter(total, weights, minimum))
